evals.prompt: 이 문서를 리더 보고용 스크롤 프레젠테이션으로 만들어줘: evals/files/avatar-realization-vision-and-roadmap.md
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML vertical scroll-snap deck written next to the input as avatar-realization-vision-and-roadmap.html, built from the skill's skeleton: 8-20 curated narrative slides (not one slide per heading), top progress bar, fixed header with phase label and NN counter, right-edge nav-dot rail with one dot per slide, IntersectionObserver active tracking, arrow-key navigation, per-slide scroll cues, print styles that stack every slide. A nav-dot outline is printed before any HTML is written. No hamburger menu, no theme toggle, no base64 font.
expectations: A nav-dot outline (slide id + label per slide) is printed to the user before the HTML file is written
Exactly one .html file is created, in the same directory and with the same basename as the input Markdown
The CSS contains 'scroll-snap-type: y mandatory'
The CSS contains 'scroll-snap-align: start' and 'scroll-snap-stop: always' on the .slide rule
The number of '<a class="deck-nav__dot"' elements equals the number of section elements whose class attribute starts with 'slide'
The slide count is between 8 and 20 inclusive
The slide count is strictly fewer than the number of '##' and '###' headings in the source Markdown (i.e. headings were merged or cut, not mapped 1:1)
Every deck-nav__dot href points at an id that exists on a .slide section
The JavaScript constructs an IntersectionObserver and uses it to set the active slide
The JavaScript moves aria-current="step" between .deck-nav__dot elements as the active slide changes
The JavaScript defines a goTo(index) function that calls scrollIntoView
A keydown handler maps ArrowDown to goTo(activeIndex + 1) and ArrowUp to goTo(activeIndex - 1)
goTo uses a reduced-motion guard, e.g. behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth"
A progress bar element exists and its width or scaleX transform is updated from scroll position
The deck header shows a slide counter whose total equals the actual slide count
Every slide except the last contains one '<a class="next-cue"' link pointing at the next slide's id, and the last slide has none
The file contains no '.viz-menu', no 'toggleMenu(', and no 'cycleTheme(' (utility menu and theme toggle are deliberately out of scope)
The file contains no base64 '@font-face' data URI (src: url("data:font...")); the webfont is loaded from a CDN link instead
The file contains an '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' block
The file contains an '@media print' block that sets scroll-snap-type to none and gives each slide a page break so all slides stack
Every slide section has an aria-labelledby attribute matching a heading id inside it
The HTML was written with a single Write tool call (no second Write to the same path)
No HTML markup from the generated file appears in the assistant's chat response
The final response contains a file:// URL for the generated deck
